visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair, wearing a black pleated jacket over a black shirt, stands in a studio setting. He looks directly at the camera and gestures with his hands. The background is a dimly lit grey with blurred professional camera equipment. (2) The scene shifts to an urban landscape in South Korea under an overcast sky; a South Korean flag flutters prominently in the foreground while traffic moves on the streets below. (3) A close-up shows a person's hands holding a silver smartphone, followed by a close-up of a hand zipping up a black puffer jacket. (4) The speaker reappears in the studio, continuing his hand gestures. (5) An AI-generated cartoonish illustration of a middle-aged man is shown; he wears a black Supreme cap, a grey 'SOLID' t-shirt, a black crossbody bag, and holds an orange iPhone. (6) A low-angle montage features the legs and feet of various people walking on a city sidewalk, focusing on their sneakers, including brands like Nike and Hoka. (7) Screenshots of digital articles and web pages appear, displaying text in Traditional Chinese and images of clothing brands and social media posts. (8) The speaker is shown again, this time against a bright yellow background filled with large white question mark symbols and text overlays summarizing his points.

(3) [Subtitle]: 沒想到最近 Young Forty 反而變成 年輕世代嘲笑的目標 甚至還傳出有品牌. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為中年人愛穿 股價就狂掉 今天就讓我們一起來聊聊 Young Forty 吧. (5) [Subtitle]: 前陣子 iPhone 17 發表會之後呢 這張 AI 生成圖 就在韓國社群上面爆紅. [Logo]: Solid. (9) [Subtitle]: 他們批評這些中年大叔老是 裝懂 裝年輕 網路上面甚至還流傳. [Variety]: 裝懂 裝年輕. (10) [Subtitle]: Young Forty 品牌清單 提醒年輕世代 避開這些大叔制服. (11) [Subtitle]: 甚至還有證券分析師說 某些運動鞋品牌的股價下跌.
